title: ShieldCare Excess: the Loading for Claims Already Filed
content:
## The loading

The excess on an approved claim under a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan carries a loading where
claims have already been filed on the plan over the window counted.

| What the plan shows over the window counted | The loading for the claims already filed |
| --- | --- |
| 3 or more claims stand filed on the plan, and the plan is one that puts its cover back at each anniversary | 75.00 |
| 2 claims stand filed over that window | 35.00 |
| every other plan | no loading for the claims already filed is added |

## Points of judgement on the rows

The upper row needs both limbs together: 3 or more claims on a plan that does not put its cover back at
each anniversary does not reach it. The middle row is drawn on exactly 2 claims filed over the window;
a single claim reaches neither row. A plan that does not put its cover back at each anniversary and
carries 3 claims over the window therefore falls to the third row, where no loading is added.

## The combinations set out

| Claims filed over the window counted | Plan puts cover back at each anniversary | Loading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | no | none |
| 1 | yes | none |
| 2 | no | 35.00 |
| 2 | yes | 35.00 |
| 3 | no | none |
| 3 | yes | 75.00 |
| 4 | yes | 75.00 |
